sections.title: Purpose of Ember Vault
paragraphs: Ember Vault is an offline information storage, retrieval, and reference system designed to make educational and reference materials available when internet access may be limited or unavailable.
Information provided through Ember Vault is intended for general informational and educational purposes only.
Ember Vault is not a substitute for professional judgment, training, or services.

sections.title: No Professional Advice
paragraphs: Information available through Ember Vault does not constitute professional medical, legal, engineering, electrical, veterinary, financial, emergency-response, survival, or other professional advice.
Users are responsible for evaluating information and determining whether it is appropriate for their particular circumstances.
When qualified professional assistance or emergency services are reasonably available, users should seek appropriate professional assistance rather than relying solely on Ember Vault.

sections.title: Medical and Health Information
paragraphs: Medical, first-aid, herbal, medicinal-plant, nutritional, sanitation, and other health-related information provided through Ember Vault is for informational and educational purposes only.
Ember Vault does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease or medical conditions.

Natural, herbal, or traditional remedies are not necessarily safe merely because they are natural or have historically been used for a particular purpose. Plants and other substances may be toxic, may be incorrectly identified, may cause allergic reactions, and may interact with prescription medications, over-the-counter medications, supplements, or existing medical conditions.

Users should obtain appropriate medical assistance whenever reasonably possible, particularly for serious injuries, poisoning, severe illness, allergic reactions, difficulty breathing, altered consciousness, significant bleeding, or other potentially life-threatening conditions.

sections.title: Plant, Mushroom, and Natural-Material Identification
paragraphs: Information concerning edible, medicinal, poisonous, or otherwise useful plants, fungi, and natural materials carries inherent risk.
Misidentification may result in serious injury or death.
Users should not consume or administer a plant, mushroom, herb, or other natural substance solely because an Ember Vault search result appears to identify it as safe.
Multiple reliable identification methods and appropriately qualified references should be used whenever possible.

sections.title: Food, Water, and Sanitation
paragraphs: Improper food preservation, canning, preparation, storage, water treatment, or sanitation practices can cause serious illness or death.
Users are responsible for evaluating procedures against current authoritative guidance whenever such guidance is available.

sections.title: Outdoor, Survival, Hunting, Fishing, and Similar Activities
paragraphs: Survival techniques, hunting, trapping, fishing, fire making, shelter construction, navigation, tool use, and similar activities may involve substantial risk.
Users are responsible for their own actions, equipment, environment, skill level, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Laws concerning hunting, fishing, trapping, firearms, radio communications, land access, controlled substances, protected species, and other activities vary by jurisdiction and may change over time.
Offline information stored in Ember Vault may therefore not reflect current law.

sections.title: Electrical, Mechanical, Construction, and Repair Information
paragraphs: Electrical work, machinery, generators, batteries, fuel systems, structural work, vehicle repair, and other technical activities may result in fire, electrocution, explosion, property damage, serious injury, or death if performed incorrectly.
Users undertake such activities at their own risk and should obtain qualified assistance whenever appropriate and available.

sections.title: Third-Party Materials
paragraphs: Ember Vault may contain, index, download, or provide access to information created by governments, universities, publishers, organizations, authors, and other third parties.
Unless expressly stated otherwise, the inclusion of third-party material does not mean that its creator endorses Ember Vault or that Ember Vault independently guarantees its accuracy.
Third-party materials remain subject to their respective authorship, licensing, copyright, attribution, and disclaimer terms.

sections.title: User-Imported Content
paragraphs: Users may add their own documents and other materials to Ember Vault.
The Ember Vault developers do not review, verify, endorse, or guarantee user-imported material.
Users are responsible for ensuring that their possession and use of imported content complies with applicable law.

sections.title: Artificial Intelligence and Search Results
paragraphs: Ember Vault may use automated search, retrieval, ranking, summarization, or artificial-intelligence technologies to help locate and present information.
These systems can make mistakes.
They may misunderstand a question, retrieve an inappropriate source, omit important context, combine information incorrectly, or produce an inaccurate or incomplete response.
Users should consult the underlying source material, particularly before making decisions involving health, safety, or other significant consequences.

sections.title: Information May Become Outdated
paragraphs: Ember Vault is specifically designed to operate offline.
As a consequence, downloaded information may become outdated.
Medical recommendations, laws, regulations, safety standards, product information, emergency procedures, and scientific understanding may change after material has been downloaded.
Where connectivity and reliable current information are available, users should verify important information against current authoritative sources.

sections.title: No Guarantee
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Ember Vault and its content are provided "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE," without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied.
No guarantee is made regarding the accuracy, completeness, reliability, availability, fitness for a particular purpose, or safety of information retrieved through Ember Vault.

sections.title: Assumption of Risk
paragraphs: Users are responsible for determining how information obtained through Ember Vault is used.
Activities undertaken based on information found through Ember Vault may involve inherent risks.
By using Ember Vault, the user acknowledges that they are responsible for evaluating those risks and for their own decisions and actions.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the developers, contributors, maintainers, distributors, and other persons involved in creating or providing Ember Vault shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or similar damages arising from the use of, inability to use, or reliance upon Ember Vault or information made available through it.
Nothing in these Terms is intended to exclude or limit liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited under applicable law.

sections.title: Emergency Situations
paragraphs: Ember Vault is an information resource, not an emergency service.
When emergency communications and qualified emergency services are available, users should contact the appropriate emergency service rather than relying solely upon Ember Vault.

sections.title: Acceptance
paragraphs: By selecting "I have read and agree to the Safety Disclaimer and Terms of Use" and continuing, the user acknowledges that they have read and understood these Terms and agrees to use Ember Vault subject to them.
